g.text: 2. SIGNALS - identical net names are electrically connected; numbers at U1 are module pad numbers

g.text: Do not use flash / PSRAM pads as GPIO.
GPIO2: no external pull-up; TFT reset is an input.
GPIO12: leave unused; do not force a new boot strap.
WROVER(-I): attach the appropriate antenna before RF use.
